newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Five killed, 22 hurt in Venezuela bus accident.
newsitem.headline: Five killed, 22 hurt in Venezuela bus accident.

text.p: At least five people, three of them children, were killed and 22 injured when a bus plunged into a contaminated river in central Caracas on Tuesday, a fire brigade spokesman said.
The crowded bus was travelling on a motorway crossing the Venezuelan capital. The cause of the accident was not known, the spokesman said.
